summary: Iteration 70: Tested vendor accept/cancel 24h SLA, internal mail chain events, balance share link, and agent qty_type toggle. All 13 backend tests pass. Fixed auth helper issues in orders_router.py where _resolve_vendor_caller and mint_balance_share_link were incorrectly calling auth_helpers.get_current_admin with Request object instead of HTTPAuthorizationCredentials. Vendor UI tested successfully with acceptance banner, countdown timer, and cancel modal.

fixed.issue: Auth helper was passing Request object instead of parsing JWT manually - FIXED

critical_code_review_comments: orders_router.py now imports jwt module and manually parses tokens in _resolve_vendor_caller and mint_balance_share_link functions
Internal events module (internal_events.py) correctly configured with 4 default recipients
Vendor acceptance banner shows correctly with 24h countdown, Confirm Order and Cancel Order buttons
Agent dashboard has cart-level qty_type toggle (data-testid='cart-default-qty-type') and per-item override
Balance share link button (data-testid='agent-balance-link-{order_number}') implemented for provisional balance_pending orders

success_rate.frontend: 90% (vendor UI verified, agent OTP login flow complex to automate)

seed_data_creation: Test orders created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor accept/cancel endpoints working. Internal events fire correctly and log to db.email_logs with kind=internal_<event>. Balance share link generation and resolution working. Agent qty_type toggle implemented in frontend. The auth fix in orders_router.py manually parses JWT tokens instead of using auth_helpers.get_current_admin which expects HTTPAuthorizationCredentials from FastAPI dependency injection.
